title: Mframa ne Ogya Tumidi
intro: Fa w’adwene bu tumidi bi a mframa no ankasa bua sodifo biako, baabi a abɔde nketewa nne soa emu duru, na wɔde tumi ahorow a aniwa a ɛyɛ mpapahwekwa nhu no kura ɔsom a wɔde ahwɛyiye mu. Saa onipa yi nyaa ahenni soronko bi fii obi a odii n’anim a ɔdɔ no hɔ, na na ɔwɔ tumi wɔ wim tebea ne jinn so. Nanso tumi kɛseɛ de sɔhwɛ akɛseɛ baeɛ — na berɛ a ɛtwa toɔ bɛda biribi a ɛyɛ nwonwa adi wɔ nkwa ne owuo ankasa su ho.
clues: Me nyaa ahennie kesee bi firii ɔwofoɔ a medɔ no a ɔno nso yɛ nkɔmhyɛni ne Allah somfo hɔ.
Allah maa me tumi wɔ mframa so, somaa no kɔ nnwuma a ɛfa bosome akwantuo ho wɔ anɔpa baako mu.
Ná abɔde nketewa mpo bɛka ɔkwan a mefa so no ho asɛm, na na migyina kakra de wɔn ho dwiriw me wɔ sɛnea wohu no no ho.
Ná mehyɛ jinn, nnipa, ne nnomaa dɔm kɛse bi so, na na wɔn nyinaa hyehyɛ wɔn ho nnidiso nnidiso nnidiso nnidiso wɔ m’anim.
Sodifo bi a ɔwɔ akyirikyiri bae sɛ ɔde asɛnnennen a emu yɛ den bɛsɔ me ahwɛ, na memaa wɔde saa sodifo no ahengua baa m’ahemfie ansa na ɔhɔho no atumi asɔre afi akongua bi so mpo.
Mekɔɔ so gyinaa hɔ, de me ho too poma so, kosii sɛ asase so abɔde ketewaa bi kesee no — na ɛno ansa na wɔn a wɔatwa me ho ahyia no hui sɛ matwam.

arabic: وَلِسُلَيْمَـٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةًۭ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا ۚ وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind, blowing forcefully, proceeding by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And We are ever, of all things, Knowing. (21:81)
